title: Hina procedural character — numerical fitting summary
reportScope: Public summary of authored parameter-fitting outputs. Numerical fit scores and rendered visual-review scores are separate measures.
iterationType: Distinct numerical parameter evaluations, separate from rendered visual refinement passes

iterationAccounting.note: The total includes 40,000 earlier authoring diagnostics plus 20,000 final fixed-pose evaluations. The published full CSVs contain the final 20,000 evaluations only.

headPose.policy: Fixed to the visually accepted pose for both final numerical runs.

scoreDefinition.name: Numerical landmark alignment score
scoreDefinition.interpretation: 95 on this numerical scale corresponds to 6.26 pixels weighted RMSE; it does not establish rendered likeness or production quality.
scoreDefinition.selectionObjective: Minimize fixed-weight radial Huber loss with delta=12 pixels; retain the original weights when reporting RMSE.

method.annotationApproach: Approximate correspondences were interpreted visually. Input locations and the supplied reference are excluded from this public metadata.
method.search: Seeded shifted Halton coverage, elite-assisted refinement, reflected coordinate search, and local polish.
method.framing: Constrained camera framing is optimized with weighted least squares and robust updates; perspective framing uses exact projection derivatives.
method.evaluationAccounting: Only unique outer candidate evaluations are counted; internal framing-solver steps are excluded.
limitations: Sparse landmark error does not measure complete silhouette, materials, expression, occlusion, or side-view quality.
Approximate annotations and stylized anatomy can leave persistent residuals; those residuals were retained.
The accepted head pose remained fixed during the final comparison.
